name: TOTP Enrollment to Confirmation
summary: An authenticated user reviews the generated authenticator enrollment material and continues to the TOTP confirmation surface.

preconditions.expression: an authenticated durable identity without enabled TOTP is viewing enrollment material produced for the current enrollment attempt

postconditions.expression: the same authenticated durable identity remains signed in with TOTP still disabled while auth.mfa.totp.confirm is visible

sourceReferences.note: The web component loads enrollment material and action:continue navigates to the canonical confirm route.
